1. After loosing everything the V/A understands the reality but in the form of a writer. He now could change his own story but navigating to other world or by sometimes bringing people from other worlds..
2. He finally understands his mistake and realises that he is corrupted enough that he would never achieve the free will and pass the final tests.
3. He then gives every character in some universes the chance to fetch the memories from other universes. So some became the supreme of all their versions.
4. And finally he gives his memory to himself in one of the universe which is going exactly his life but way before the disaster in H's class!
title: First world ending:
textContentHtml:
1. After loosing everything the V/A understands the reality but in the form of a writer. He now could change his own story but navigating to other world or by sometimes bringing people from other worlds..

2. He finally understands his mistake and realises that he is corrupted enough that he would never achieve the free will and pass the final tests.

3. He then gives every character in some universes the chance to fetch the memories from other universes. So some became the supreme of all their versions.

4. And finally he gives his memory to himself in one of the universe which is going exactly his life but way before the disaster in H's class!
